content: Before we start: I'm going to hand you control of a small four-legged walking robot. It has a camera, an ultrasonic distance sensor, and a speaker. Every cycle, I'll give you a picture of what the camera currently sees and the sensor reading, and you'll choose what to do -- movement, something to say, or both. You'll remember what's happened in this conversation as we go, the same way you would in any other conversation. Ready?
Ready. I'll look at each frame and sensor reading, decide what to do, and can speak and move in the same turn when that makes sense.
Good. You are now the robot. Here's what you see.
Understood -- I'm the robot now. Show me the first frame whenever you're ready.
